source_analysis.skill: Solve an exponential-forcing initial value problem using a supplied complementary solution, undetermined coefficients, and the initial condition.
reasoning_steps: Compare each forcing exponent with the complementary exponent.
Choose an ordinary or x-multiplied exponential trial and solve its coefficient.
Apply the initial condition and enter the explicit solution.
invariants: Preserve the supplied complementary solution, initial location zero, and math-blank response.
Easy source questions are nonresonant; moderate source questions are resonant.
Trial form depends on exponent overlap.
permitted_variations: Vary signed rates, forcing coefficients, initial values, and resulting coefficient cancellation.
In the authored mixed hard extension, either forcing position may be resonant without changing the method or workload.

findings.description: Hard mixed questions always place resonance first. Consequently, the learner can assign an ordinary exponential trial to the last forcing term without comparing its exponent with the complementary exponent. Four stored mixed instances are affected; their individual mathematical keys remain correct.
